personality_one_liner: A refined, trusted urban marketplace connecting local citizens with verified city stores, direct WhatsApp conversion, and multi-tier SaaS merchant tools.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous iOS-native vertical spacing, comfortable touch targets (>=44pt), and clean horizontal padding.

do's: Use frosted glass header and bottom navigation over scrolling content
Apply translucent tinted glass for featured store highlight cards
dont's: Never apply blur to form inputs or body text
Never stack multiple heavy blur layers

screens.name: RoleSwitcher
screens.purpose: Seamless profile switcher between Consumidor, Lojista (Painel da Loja), and Super Admin with demo accounts.

states.loading: Centered minimalist spinner with warm amber brand accent
states.error: Failed to authenticate session. Please retry.

screens.layout: Centered immersive card stack presenting the 3 integrated platform profiles with instant demo one-tap entry.

screens.name: ConsumerExplore
screens.purpose: City Store Explorer by categories, featured stores, verified badges, and search.

states.loading: Shimmer card skeletons simulating store items
states.empty: No stores found in this category. Try another filter.
states.error: Unable to load city directory. Check network connection.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll with top sticky glass search header, horizontal category pill selector, and single-column store cards with verified badges and ratings.

screens.name: StoreDetail
screens.purpose: Comprehensive store profile with 1-click WhatsApp, direct phone, map address, product catalog, and reviews.

states.loading: Cover banner skeleton and shimmer list rows
states.empty: No products listed in catalog yet.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero banner with gradient scrim, sticky bottom action bar with 1-Click WhatsApp CTA, collapsible catalog grid, and review feed.

screens.name: StoreOwnerDashboard
screens.purpose: Store owner analytics, SaaS plan upgrades (Free, Pro, Premium), catalog management, and banner promotions.

states.empty: No analytics data recorded yet for this billing cycle.

screens.layout: Scrollable dashboard with KPI metric cards, SaaS Plan Upgrade banner, catalog quick actions, and traffic analytics.

screens.name: SuperAdminPanel
screens.purpose: Platform-wide management of registered city stores, SaaS subscription tiers, verification badges, and system revenue.

states.empty: No registered merchant stores found in platform database.

screens.layout: Executive overview cards, pending verification store list with approve/reject actions, and global SaaS tier distribution chart.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement 3 integrated profiles (Consumidor, Lojista, Super Admin) with a RoleSwitcher screen. Use iOS-Native Clean personality with warm ochre and amber accents. Ensure 1-click WhatsApp conversion, SaaS plan tiers (Grátis, Pro, Premium), catalog management, and verified badges. Strictly adhere to touch targets >= 44pt, loading/empty/error states on all screens, and no banned colors.
